theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme with clean trend-health (hurst_tag 'trend', durability 0.76 — highest in ranks), strong breadth (0.8 vs Banks 0.69), and negligible crowding (z 0.15). While Banks leads on rank, Energy's momentum is more internally coherent and trend-confirmed, making it the better staying-power candidate given the one validated leg (absolute-trend gate) is active. This is a relative-tilt call: I would hold Energy exposure over other eligible names on the basis of trend durability, NOT on rank.
theses.dissent: Energy is a cyclical beta play; if the macro risk-off deepening that has knocked 13/17 themes ineligible hits commodities too, H-share energy names will lag defensives. The 0.33 margin to Banks is thin and Banks is the leader — betting against the leader on durability alone has a poor track record.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the headline leader (rank 1, score 1.313) and one of only 4 eligible themes, with reasonable breadth (0.692) and no crowding (z 0.93 is high-ish but not flagged crowded). Given the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge and it is ON for Banks, maintaining rather than adding exposure is defensible. Durability is mixed (hurst 'mixed', 0.67), so conviction stays low and this is a hold-lean, not a fresh accumulation call.
theses.dissent: Banks are rate-sensitive; a dovish monetary surprise (macro_narrative shows 1 monetary headline, 75% unscheduled share) would compress NIM expectations and hit H-share banks disproportionately. Breadth 0.69 is weaker than Energy's 0.8 — the leader's edge is not broad-based.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech (3033.HK, scorable) is rank 13 with score -0.792 and is ineligible (absolute-trend gate OFF). Hurst is 'mean-revert' — precisely the regime where the trend gate shuts down and where historically this theme has chopped rather than trended. This is an avoid, not a short (guardrails forbid fade calls). The detector gives no basis to own a mean-reverting, ineligible theme, especially one of the only two scorable proxies.
evidence: gate_helps == true (gate OFF means shake-out risk uncompensated)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags sometimes mark bottoms, not chop; a strong policy catalyst (macro_narrative shows 3 AI/tech headlines) could spark a snap-back that an 'avoid' misses. The avoid is a discipline call, not a return forecast, so missing upside is the cost being paid.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK (China Tech) posts a 10%+ total return over the next 21 trading days AND the absolute-trend gate flips eligible

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
